_comment: Measured baseline: 330.9 KiB gzip first paint; the budget is that plus ~2%.
Splitting the message dictionary by consumer took it to 319.6 (measured before
and after on the same machine): the copy only a hosted deployment renders is no
longer in this build at all. The budget stays where it is — a ceiling that has
just gained headroom is not a reason to move it in the same change.
The three JavaScript budgets share one number, so any chunk that grows past
the entry's ceiling is caught wherever it appears.
2026-08-19: those numbers described the pre-split tree and were carried across
the Cloud/Community split unchanged, so they stopped describing this build. On
the split commit the first paint was already 357.4 KiB and this gate was red —
measured at 045c13ae and at its two parents: 319.5 before the frontend rewrite,
327.2 after it, 357.4 after the split. Nothing in the tree said so, because the
server-side evidence was not running.
Declaring `sideEffects` on the workspace packages brought it to 308.2 KiB: the
shell imports the @fairlb/ui barrel, and without that declaration the bundler
must assume every module the barrel re-exports has side effects, so zod and
Kumo's Combobox and Select could not be dropped from the initial graph.
The budget stays at 340 for the reason stated above.
2026-08-19, after the two fixes met: 254.8 KiB. The figures above were taken
in a tree that had both pnpm workspaces installed, where the Community build
resolved its shared libraries through two stores at once and bundled two
copies of each; `make verify-public` now measures on a copy of public/ alone,
which is the resolution public/Dockerfile builds in. So 357.4 and 308.2 both
described a bundle nobody ships, and the sideEffects declarations are worth
more than the 49 KiB they appeared to be. The budget still stays at 340.

2026-08-21：入口那一档已删（ADR-0158）。它此前是「入口 chunk 专属的、比 javascript 更紧的第四个上限」，而入口 chunk 已经被 javascript（按 chunk）与 initialJavascript（按首屏）各管一次；它独有度量的是 chunk 拓扑，那不是任何人付出的成本。它两次为拓扑位移报红（首屏同时持平或变好），两次的唯一可行答复都是抬闸——一条每次被碰到就得挪的线不是天花板。入口大小仍然打印，是读数不是闸。
